newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares rise, central market listless.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares rise, central market listless.

text.p: Shares gained in listless central market turnover on Lithuania's bourse on Friday, dealers said.
Brokers said further gains were expected as shares were still undervalued but anticipated that summer would keep a lid on turnover.
The official list index, comprised of the top five blue chips, jumped 14.11 points to 898.52 points, while group A shares edged up 1.98 points to 1873.69 points.
Central market turnover was a dull 172,323 litas from 411,026 litas, but block trades turned two million litas from 581,703 litas.
Vilniaus Bank grew to 230.00 litas from 220.10 litas on central market turnover of 50,370 litas and block trades worth 230,000 litas at the same price.
Brokers say Vilniaus Bank shares will stay reasonably liquid at 230.00 litas but that sellers will hold if prices go lower.
Rival Hermis Bank remained stable at 190.00 litas amid sleepy central market turnover of 570.00 litas.
Hermis shares faired better in block trades, where they turned over almost 1.2 million litas at prices ranging from 185.00 litas to 195.00 litas.
"Hermis Bank shares are doing better than Vilniaus Bank as far as liquidity," said one broker.
